description:
Position: Kentico developer 
 Duration: 3 months contract to hire 
 
 
 · Responsible for the hands-on, front-end development of websites using Kentico CMS on behalf of the Digital Marketing team.
 · Collaborate with IT to ensure the optimal and standardized implementation and maintenance of integrated backend systems and applications.
 · Work with managers and stakeholders to ensure data flows to/from websites and backend systems.
 · Work closely with external vendors to ensure technical requirements are met.
 · Work closely with Digital Marketing Manager and other marketing managers to communicate status of projects.
 
 · Associate’s Degree in computer science, marketing or related field OR 4 years related experience
 · Enterprise level CMS development experience (i.e. Kentico, Sitecore, Ektron, Adobe, Acquia, etc.)
 · Cross-platform/browser development
 · SQL server database design;
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 · Front-end web design and development (i.e. Photoshop)
 · Advanced troubleshooting for backend and 3rd party integrations
